prompts.name: Product label
prompts.prompt: A straight-on studio product photograph of one matte cobalt-blue water bottle standing on a pale stone plinth, with soft light from the left. Its white label reads ORBIT in large letters, with 500 ml beneath it. Use a warm off-white backdrop. No other objects or text.

prompts.name: Editorial portrait
prompts.prompt: An editorial waist-up portrait of an adult ceramic artist in a dark green apron, holding a small unglazed clay bowl in both hands. A workshop window lights the left side of their face. Include a softly blurred shelf in the background and keep the bowl and hands in focus.

prompts.name: Spatial layout
prompts.prompt: An overhead photograph of a cream table with exactly three objects: a red apple at the top left, a blue ceramic cup at the top right, and a single silver spoon below the apple. Leave the bottom right empty. Keep every object fully in frame.

prompts.name: Limited-palette illustration
prompts.prompt: A cut-paper illustration of a cyclist passing a small bus shelter in the rain. Use exactly four colors: navy, warm cream, muted orange, and slate blue. Show layered paper edges and a clear silhouette, with no lettering.
